observation initial-volume
  quantity 12 L measured

observation initial-salt-fraction
  quantity 0.25 1 measured

observation target-salt-fraction
  quantity 0.15 1 assumed

claim initial-salt-volume
  = initial-volume * initial-salt-fraction

claim final-volume
  = initial-salt-volume / target-salt-fraction

claim water-to-add
  = final-volume - initial-volume

claim final-answer
  The answer is C.

link water-to-add supports final-answer

model holds final-answer
  confidence 1 assumed
